neighbours.label: going wrong: the token that completes a word or phrase for error, failure or being stuck ('erroneously', 'mired', 'beset by', 'raté', 'a mistake on'), as against the same sentences framed as success
fire: The negotiations have been mired in disputes for months.
The report erroneously listed him as deceased.
From the start the expedition was beset by bad weather.
Hier soir, j'ai complètement raté mon examen de conduite.
The early program was mired in bugs and delays.
The article mistakenly claimed that the bridge had collapsed.
The rollout was beset by crashes and angry customers.
The census erroneously counted the town twice.
quiet: The negotiations have moved forward quickly this month.
The report correctly listed him as the new director.
From the start the expedition was blessed with good weather.
Hier soir, j'ai réussi mon examen de conduite.
The early program was fast and reliable.
The article accurately described how the bridge was built.
The rollout went smoothly and customers were pleased.
The census carefully counted every house in town.
